fareRules.title: Description
fareRules.text:
Flight Cancellation, Rescheduling

& Booking Modification Terms

Applicable to flight bookings serviced through the Spentro platform

1. Flight Cancellation Terms

Flight cancellations are subject to the applicable airline fare rules, fare conditions, regulatory requirements and Spentro servicing policies.

Online cancellation is available only for eligible bookings supported by the applicable airline, supplier and the Spentro platform. Availability may vary by airline, fare type, route, booking status and time remaining before departure.

Bookings that cannot be cancelled online, including certain group bookings, multi-city itineraries, partially travelled journeys, airline-restricted bookings or bookings requiring manual intervention, shall be processed through Spentro's request-based servicing flow.

Online Request-based cancellation requests should preferably be submitted at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled departure. Requests received within 24 hours of departure will be handled on a best-effort basis, subject to airline servicing cut-offs, fare rules and operational feasibility. 

Where a traveller is unable to cancel the booking directly through the Platform due to the proximity of the scheduled departure or applicable airline servicing restrictions, the traveller may be required to contact the airline directly to process the cancellation. If such a request falls within Spentro’s defined Customer Service Hours, the Customer Service team will assist the traveller with the cancellation, subject to the applicable airline’s fare rules and servicing cut-offs. If the request falls outside Customer Service Hours, the traveller shall be responsible for contacting the airline directly and completing the cancellation within the applicable airline-prescribed timeline.

No-show bookings shall be subject to the applicable airline's no-show, cancellation and refund rules. Applicable no-show penalties and other charges may be deducted from any eligible refund.

The refundable amount, if any, shall be determined after deduction of applicable airline cancellation charges, no-show penalties, supplier charges, Spentro service fees, convenience fees and non-refundable ancillary services, as applicable.

Refunds shall ordinarily be processed to the original payment method used for the booking, unless a different method is required by the applicable corporate payment arrangement, airline, supplier or payment provider.

Refund eligibility and amounts remain subject to airline or supplier confirmation. Final credit timelines may additionally depend on the payment gateway, card network, issuing bank or other financial institution.

Spentro may disable or decline online cancellation where airline, supplier, fare, technical or operational restrictions apply and may route the request through a request-based servicing flow.

The Refund amount would be processed in 7-10 business days.

2. Flight Rescheduling Terms

Flight rescheduling is subject to the applicable airline fare rules, seat and fare availability, ticket validity, regulatory requirements and Spentro servicing policies.

Online rescheduling is available only for eligible bookings supported by the applicable airline, supplier and Spentro platform. Availability may vary by airline, fare type, route, booking status and time remaining before departure.

Online rescheduling shall remain available only until the applicable airline or system servicing cut-off for the booking. A booking may cease to qualify for online rescheduling even where the airline separately permits a change through another servicing channel.

Bookings requiring manual servicing, including certain group bookings, multi-city itineraries, partially travelled journeys and airline-restricted bookings, shall be processed through Spentro's request-based rescheduling flow.

Request-based rescheduling requests should preferably be submitted at least 24 hours prior to scheduled departure. Requests received closer to departure will be handled on a best-effort basis, subject to airline servicing cut-offs, fare and seat availability and operational feasibility.

Rescheduling may be subject to airline change penalties, fare differences, tax differences, supplier charges and applicable Spentro service fees. All amounts are subject to availability and final confirmation at the time of reissue.

Where applicable, any eligible value or refund from the original booking may be adjusted against the cost of the revised itinerary, subject to airline and supplier rules.

A revised itinerary or ticket shall be issued only after the required airline or supplier confirmation and successful settlement of all applicable charges.

Spentro may determine, based on airline, supplier and system capabilities, whether a booking can be serviced online or must be handled through the request-based servicing flow.

3. Booking Modification Terms

Minor passenger name corrections may be processed through the online request-based servicing flow, subject to airline approval, documentary requirements and applicable charges.

Complete passenger name changes or transfer of a ticket to another passenger are generally not permitted unless expressly allowed by the applicable airline and fare rules.

Travel date changes are treated as rescheduling and remain subject to airline fare rules, seat and fare availability, ticket validity and applicable charges.

Sector or routing changes are subject to airline fare rules and system capabilities and may require ticket reissue or cancellation of the existing booking followed by creation of a new booking.

Cabin or fare-family upgrades are subject to airline availability, fare rules, system capability and payment of applicable fare differences and charges.

Seat selection, meal changes, baggage additions and other ancillary modifications are subject to airline availability, policies and system capabilities and may require request-based servicing where online modification is unavailable.

Additional passengers cannot ordinarily be added to an existing issued ticket and will require a separate booking.

Removal of one or more passengers from a booking is subject to airline and PNR rules and may require request-based servicing or cancellation and rebooking.

All booking modification requests may attract applicable airline charges, fare differences, taxes, supplier charges and Spentro service fees.

4. Airline-Initiated Cancellation and Schedule Changes

Where an airline cancels, reschedules, reroutes or otherwise materially modifies a flight, the remedies available to the traveller, including alternate flights, rescheduling, travel credit or refund, shall be determined by the applicable airline's policy and fare conditions.

Spentro will facilitate the options made available or confirmed by the airline or supplier but does not control airline schedules, inventory, waivers, approvals, operational decisions or refund determinations.

Any refund arising from an airline-initiated cancellation or schedule change remains subject to confirmation and processing by the applicable airline or supplier.

Travellers should review and respond promptly to airline or Spentro communications relating to schedule changes, as available alternatives and inventory may change.

5. Customer Service and Business Hours

Customer Support is available Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM India Standard Time (IST), excluding published holidays, unless otherwise agreed with the applicable corporate client.

Requests received outside the applicable business hours will be acknowledged and serviced from the next business day, unless covered by a separately contracted after-hours or emergency support arrangement.

Published Service Level Agreements (SLAs) apply only during the applicable service window unless expressly stated otherwise.

Emergency or near-departure travel requests are handled on a best-effort basis and remain subject to airline servicing capabilities, airline cut-offs, system availability and operational feasibility.

6. Refund Terms

Refund eligibility and the refundable amount shall be determined in accordance with the applicable airline or supplier fare rules and conditions.

Convenience fees, Spentro service fees and non-refundable ancillary services are non-refundable unless expressly stated otherwise or required by applicable law.

Taxes and statutory charges shall be refunded only to the extent permitted or returned by the applicable airline or supplier and as required by applicable law.

Refunds shall ordinarily be credited to the original payment method, subject to the applicable corporate payment arrangement and payment-provider requirements.

Once the applicable refund has been confirmed and/or received from the airline or supplier, Spentro will initiate the eligible refund in accordance with its applicable servicing timelines.

The time required for the refunded amount to reflect in the original payment method may vary depending on the airline or supplier, payment gateway, card network, issuing bank or other financial institution. Spentro is not responsible for delays attributable to such third parties.

Where a refund is pending with an airline or supplier, any timeline communicated by Spentro is indicative and subject to the airline's or supplier's final processing.

7. General Terms

All cancellation, rescheduling and booking modification requests are subject to applicable airline fare rules, supplier conditions, regulatory requirements and system capabilities.

The fare-specific rules and charges displayed for a flight or fare at the time of search, booking or servicing form part of the applicable terms. In the event of a conflict regarding airline-imposed conditions, the applicable airline or supplier fare rules shall prevail.

Cancellation charges, change penalties, fare differences, taxes, supplier charges and other amounts displayed during servicing may be estimates until the transaction is confirmed by the airline or supplier.

All applicable airline penalties, fare differences, taxes, supplier charges and Spentro service fees shall be payable by the customer or the relevant corporate account, as applicable.

Spentro acts as a booking facilitator and servicing platform and does not determine or control airline fare rules, flight schedules, inventory, operational decisions, refund eligibility or supplier processing timelines.

Spentro shall not be responsible for delays, cancellations, schedule changes, operational disruptions, force majeure events, airport closures, governmental or regulatory restrictions, airline or supplier system failures, or other circumstances beyond its reasonable control.

Nothing in these terms limits any right or remedy that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited under applicable law.

Spentro may update these servicing terms from time to time to reflect changes in airline or supplier policies, regulatory requirements, platform capabilities or operational processes. The terms applicable to a transaction will be those presented or incorporated into the booking or servicing flow at the relevant time.

8. Fare-Specific Information Display

The cancellation and rescheduling conditions shown against an individual flight result or on the flight detail page are fare-specific summaries intended to help the customer understand the principal conditions before booking.

Fare-specific information may include whether cancellation or rescheduling is permitted, applicable airline penalties, Spentro service fees, fare differences, no-show conditions and relevant servicing cut-offs.

Where a fare-specific summary differs from a general servicing term because of a particular airline or fare condition, the applicable airline or supplier fare rule shall govern that condition.

Customers should review the fare rules and applicable charges presented before completing the booking or confirming a servicing transaction.

  • Note: These terms are intended to operate together with the applicable corporate travel policy, Spentro's platform terms, the relevant airline/supplier fare rules and any client-specific commercial or service-level arrangement.
